item.title: Ozone groups and centers of two-parameter quantum Heisenberg algebras
item.description: arXiv:2610.31781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Let $p,q$ be roots of unity with $pq\neq1$, and put $\ell=|\langle p,q\rangle|$ and $t=\ord(pq)$. Up to isomorphism, the two-parameter quantum Heisenberg algebras $\mathcal H_{p,q}$ are exactly the noetherian PI graded down-up algebras, so everything here holds for that whole class. The ozone group is $\mu_\ell\times\mu_{\ell/t}$, generated by conjugation by three normal elements, and the center is recovered from the fixed ring of the ozone group as the invariants of a cyclic group of order $t$. We give a presentation of the center as a hypersurface over a cyclic quotient surface singularity. It is regular exactly when $1$ is a characteristic root, which disproves a conjecture of Chan, Gaddis, Won and Zhang, and Gorenstein exactly when $p^{m/h}=q^{n/h}$, where $m=\ord(p)$, $n=\ord(q)$ and $h=\gcd(m,n)$; for $p=\zeta_5$, $q=\zeta_5^{2}$ it is not. We also decide when the fixed ring of the ozone group is Gorenstein and when $\mathcal H_{p,q}$ is Calabi--Yau, and show that the algebras with regular center have non-affine automorphisms and nonzero locally nilpotent derivations.
item.dc:creator: James G\'omez, H\'ector Su\'arez, Helbert Venegas

item.title: Vertex operator algebra realizations of untwisted Haagerup--Izumi centers
item.description: arXiv:2610.32928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For every odd integer $N\geq3$, we construct an untwisted Haagerup--Izumi fusion category $\mathcal H_N$ on the negative spherical branch and a simple, self-contragredient, regular, $C_2$-cofinite vertex operator algebra $E_N$ of central charge $-16N$, together with an equivalence of modular fusion categories: \[ \operatorname{Rep}(E_N)\simeq Z(\mathcal H_N). \] The VOA $E_N$ is rational, has exactly $N^2+3$ irreducible modules, and is lower bounded and integer graded, with least conformal degree $-(N-1)/2$. The proof begins with a CFT-type cyclic Virasoro extension of central charge $-5N$, whose regularity we establish. Two categorical condensations recover $\mathcal H_N$, and a finite extension by shifted lattice modules removes the auxiliary pointed factor. We identify the complete ribbon modular data of $Z(\mathcal H_N)$ with $\mathrm{MD}_{-}(\mathbb Z/N;\mathbb Z/(N^2+4),b\mapsto b^2/(N^2+4))$ in the notation of Gannon--Schopieray--Yadav, for every odd $N$.
item.dc:creator: David E. Evans, Andrew Riesen

item.title: Imaginary elements and crystals for quantum groups
item.description: arXiv:2610.32040v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we introduce the notion of stable imaginary elements in quantum groups and use crystal basis theory to construct explicit one-parameter families of such elements for all finite types. We show that all of Leclerc's examples of imaginary elements are stable imaginary. Using the generalized quantum Schur--Weyl duality, we also construct explicit examples of corresponding imaginary modules over quantum affine algebras of untwisted affine types.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Hwan Lee, Euiyong Park

item.title: Quivers with Involutions and Shifted affine $\mathrm{i}$Quantum groups via Coulomb Branches
item.description: arXiv:2610.32400v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We give a formula for quasi-minuscule monopole operators in $K$-theoretic quantized Coulomb branch algebras of cotangent type. We then study signed quivers with involutions, with orthogonal or symplectic gauge factors at the involution-fixed vertices. We construct a GKLO-type homomorphism from the corresponding shifted affine $\mathrm{i}$quantum group to an algebra of $q$-difference operators and prove that it factors through the quantized Coulomb branch algebra. These homomorphisms give geometric realizations of the shifted affine $\mathrm{i}$quantum groups in terms of dressed minuscule and quasi-minuscule monopole operators.
item.dc:creator: Yaolong Shen, Changjian Su, Zichang Wang, Rui Xiong

item.title: Relative braid group symmetries on modified iquantum groups and their modules
item.description: arXiv:2508.12041v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a comprehensive generalization of Lusztig's braid group symmetries for quasi-split iquantum groups. Specifically, we give 3 explicit rank one formulas for symmetries acting on integrable modules over a quasi-split iquantum group of arbitrary Kac-Moody type with general parameters. These symmetries are formulated in terms of idivided powers and iweights of the vectors being acted upon. We show that these symmetries are consistent with the relative braid group symmetries on iquantum groups, and they are also related to Lusztig's symmetries via quasi $K$-matrices. Furthermore, through appropriate rescaling, we obtain compatible symmetries for the integral forms of modified iquantum groups and their integrable modules. We verify that these symmetries satisfy the relative braid group relations.
item.dc:creator: Weiqiang Wang, Weinan Zhang

item.title: The Deligne--Drinfeld conjecture after OpenAI
item.description: arXiv:2610.15592v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We provide a simplified and more human-friendly version of the proof of the Deligne--Drinfeld conjecture recently given by OpenAI.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Willwacher

item.title: No braiding for quantum sl2 reps - A short proof
item.description: arXiv:2610.29748v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We give a short and self-contained proof that the category of all finite dimensional representations of quantum sl2 is not braided.
item.dc:creator: Liao Wang, Zbigniew Wojciechowski
